```go

    ...
    r.transportProtocol = 0  // PurePayload
    ...
}
```

**Required change:**
```go
func (r *rpcConfig) initialize() {
    ...
    r.transportProtocol = transport.Framed  // Change 0 to transport.Framed
    ...
}
```

This will make Framed the default transport protocol for new RPC configurations (instead of PurePayload), completing Target 3 Requirement 3.

After this change, all 6 targets will be complete (35/35 requirements).
